related_questions.question: What is the 80/20 rule in 55+ community?
related_questions.snippet: The Housing for Older Persons Act of 1995 created the famous "80/20 rule." At least 80% of occupied units must have at least one member who's 55 or older. The community must also prove they intend to house older adults. The other 20% doesn't automatically mean younger persons can move in.
